title: Gaussian CDF threshold measure stability
statement: Let $(\Omega,\mu)$ be a finite measure space, let $X\colon\Omega\to\mathbb R$ have the standard Gaussian distribution under $\mu$, and let $A\subseteq\Omega$. For $a,b\in[0,1]$, the absolute difference between the measures of $A\cap\{\omega:\Phi(X(\omega))\le a\}$ and $A\cap\{\omega:\Phi(X(\omega))\le b\}$ is at most $|a-b|$, where $\Phi$ is the standard Gaussian distribution function.
hypotheses_covered: $X$ has the standard Gaussian distribution under $\mu$.
